Cleric's remarks on Kanwar Yatra pilgrims spark controversy

Maulana Sajid Rashidi, president of the All India Imam Association, has drawn criticism for his remarks describing Kanwar Yatra pilgrims as "drug addicts," "vagrants," and "terrorists." Following his statement, BJP MLA Nandkishor Gurjar filed a police complaint against the Maulana. The controversy has led to public outcry and condemnation.
